# Roll-In-Showers.com

> Planning resource for roll-in (curbless, wheelchair-accessible) showers: ADA 2010 §608 dimensions, drainage and slope, transfers, caregiver bathing, costs from published surveys, VA/Medicare/Medicaid/IRS funding facts, and 21 pan and package planning pages.

Publisher: Aging Safely Baths & More (installer of walk-in tubs and roll-in showers since 2012; installed in one day; all 50 states, supply-only shipping to Canada)
Provider website: https://www.agingsafelybaths.com/
Phone: 1-888-779-2284
Editorial update: 2026-10-10

## Key facts used on this site
- Standard roll-in shower (2010 ADA Standards §608.2.2): 30 in. wide × 60 in. deep minimum clear inside, 60 in. entry, 30 × 60 in. clearance; threshold ½ in. max (§608.7).
- Alternate roll-in (§608.2.3): 36 × 60 in. minimum, 36 in. entry at one end of the long side. Transfer shower (§608.2.1): exactly 36 × 36 in.
- Grab bars 33–36 in. high (§609.4); hand shower hose 59 in. min (§608.6); seats 17–19 in. high (§610.3).
- Private homes are generally not covered by the ADA Standards; the site says "built to ADA dimensions", never "ADA certified".
- Cost ranges are national survey figures (Angi, Fixr, HomeGuide, This Old House), not quotes.
- Original Medicare generally does not cover bathroom remodels; VA HISA, SAH/SHA, Medicaid HCBS waivers, USDA 504 and IRS Pub 502 are explained with official links.

## Guides
- [Roll-In Showers, Clearly Explained](https://roll-in-showers.com/): Plan roll-in showers with clear guidance on entry design, wheelchair approach, kit and pan choice. Compare options, avoid common mistakes, and request help.
- [Roll-In Shower Kits: What You Get and What You Still Need](https://roll-in-showers.com/roll-in-shower-kits/): Compare roll-in shower kits and packages: pan plus wall system, multi-piece vs one-piece, what a kit leaves out, and how to check fit before you order.
- [Roll-In Shower Pans: The Foundation of a Barrier-Free Shower](https://roll-in-showers.com/roll-in-shower-pans/): How to choose a roll-in shower pan: footprints from 36×36 to 60 inches long, center vs trench drains, low vs flush entries, corner and neo-angle shapes.
- [Wheelchair-Accessible Showers Designed Around the User](https://roll-in-showers.com/wheelchair-accessible-showers/): Plan a wheelchair-accessible shower: roll-in vs transfer layouts, approach and turning space, shower wheelchairs, reachable controls and room for a caregiver.
- [Wheelchair-to-Shower Transfers: Setting Up a Safer Move](https://roll-in-showers.com/wheelchair-shower-transfer-guide/): How to set up a shower for a safe wheelchair transfer: seat height, approach side, grab bar placement, transfer benches, and when to stop transferring.
- [Barrier-Free Showers: A Practical Curbless Design Guide](https://roll-in-showers.com/barrier-free-showers/): How barrier-free (curbless) showers work: zero-entry vs low-threshold pans, recessed subfloors, linear vs center drains, waterproofing and splash control.
- [ADA Showers: What the Standards Actually Require](https://roll-in-showers.com/ada-showers/): What the 2010 ADA Standards require for roll-in and transfer showers: sizes, ½-inch thresholds, seats, grab bars, controls and the 59-inch hand shower.
- [Roll-In Shower Dimensions: Measure the Whole Approach](https://roll-in-showers.com/roll-in-shower-dimensions/): Roll-in shower dimensions explained: 30×60 and 36×60 ADA sizes, the 36×36 transfer shower, door widths, turning space, and how to measure your bathroom.
- [Roll-In Shower Cost: Real Budget Factors and Quote Checklist](https://roll-in-showers.com/roll-in-shower-cost/): What a roll-in shower conversion costs: published national ranges from Angi, Fixr and This Old House, the factors that move a quote, and how to compare bids.
- [Roll-In Shower Installation: Process, Trades and Timeline](https://roll-in-showers.com/roll-in-shower-installation/): Roll-in shower installation step by step: assessment, demolition, floor and drain work, waterproofing, pan and walls, fixtures, grab bars and testing.
- [Tub-to-Shower Conversion for a Lower, Easier Entry](https://roll-in-showers.com/tub-to-shower-conversion/): Converting a bathtub to a roll-in shower: alcove measurements, drain position, curbless options, valve height, walls, resale questions and cost ranges.
- [Walk-In or Roll-In? Planning for Changing Mobility](https://roll-in-showers.com/walk-in-showers-for-seniors/): How changing mobility affects shower choice: when a walk-in is enough, when to plan a roll-in for a walker or wheelchair, and how to future-proof it.
- [Shower Seats and Benches: Size, Support and Placement](https://roll-in-showers.com/shower-seats-benches/): Choose a roll-in shower seat: folding wall seats, L-shaped seats, built-in benches, shower chairs and transfer benches, with heights and blocking.
- [Roll-In Shower Grab Bars, Controls and Accessories](https://roll-in-showers.com/grab-bars-accessories/): Grab bar heights, diameters and layouts for roll-in showers, plus hand showers, anti-scald valves, lever controls, curtains and storage you can reach seated.
- [Roll-In Showers for Small Bathrooms: Layout Strategies](https://roll-in-showers.com/small-bathroom-roll-in-showers/): Fit a roll-in shower in a small bathroom: overlapping clear floor space, door swaps, wall-hung sinks, corner pans, curtains instead of glass, and 5×8 layouts.
- [Roll-In vs Walk-In Shower: The Important Differences](https://roll-in-showers.com/roll-in-vs-walk-in-shower/): Roll-in vs walk-in showers compared: threshold height, size, wheelchair use, enclosure, drainage, cost drivers and the marketing terms that blur them.
- [Accessible Showers for Veterans: VA Program Planning](https://roll-in-showers.com/veterans-accessible-showers/): How veterans can pay for an accessible shower: VA HISA lifetime limits, SAH and SHA grant amounts, who qualifies, and the order of steps before work starts.
- [Funding an Accessible Bathroom: Programs and Questions](https://roll-in-showers.com/funding-accessible-bathroom/): Funding a roll-in shower: what Medicare covers and does not, Medicaid waivers, VA grants, USDA repair loans, Area Agencies on Aging and IRS Pub 502.
- [DIY Roll-In Shower: Scope, Risks and an Installation Plan](https://roll-in-showers.com/diy-roll-in-shower/): A realistic DIY plan for a roll-in shower: tasks homeowners can handle, the ones that need a plumber or framer, permits, flood testing and when to stop work.
- [Roll-In Shower Ideas: Accessible Design That Looks Great](https://roll-in-showers.com/roll-in-shower-design-ideas/): Accessible roll-in shower design ideas: continuous floors, linear drains, contrast for low vision, warm lighting, matte grab bars, curtains and niches.
- [About Roll-In-Showers.com](https://roll-in-showers.com/about/): Who publishes Roll-In-Showers.com, how guides are researched and sourced, how product links work, and how Aging Safely Baths helps with roll-in showers.
- [Roll-In Shower Planning Library](https://roll-in-showers.com/blog/): Every roll-in shower guide in one place: dimensions, ADA rules, drainage, transfers, caregiver bathing, costs, VA and Medicare funding, pans and installation.
- [Slip-Resistant Floors for Roll-In Showers](https://roll-in-showers.com/blog/slip-resistant-roll-in-shower-floors/): Compare slip-resistant floor options for roll-in showers: textured pans, small tile, DCOF ratings, mats, and the cleaning habits that keep traction.
- [Accessible Bathroom Planning Checklist](https://roll-in-showers.com/blog/accessible-bathroom-planning-checklist/): A 10-part planning checklist for an accessible bathroom with a roll-in shower: the user brief, route, shell vs usable size, water, blocking, controls, budget.
- [Curbless Shower Drainage, Slope and Splash Control](https://roll-in-showers.com/blog/roll-in-shower-drainage-splash-control/): How curbless roll-in showers drain: code slope of ¼ to ½ inch per foot, linear vs center drains, recessed floors, flood tests and splash control.
- [Caregiver-Assisted Shower Design: Space, Reach and Dignity](https://roll-in-showers.com/blog/caregiver-assisted-shower-design/): Set up a roll-in shower for assisted bathing: where the caregiver stands, shower commode chairs, hand shower reach, privacy, water temperature and supplies.
- [Questions to Ask a Roll-In Shower Contractor](https://roll-in-showers.com/blog/questions-to-ask-shower-contractor/): Questions to ask before hiring a roll-in shower installer: license, insurance, product and drain plan, waterproofing, blocking, permits and warranty.
